name: Breakfast Panzanella with Prosciutto, Tomatoes, Mozzarella & Eggs

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs in a medium saucepan, cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 4 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Peel and mince garlic. Cut or tear the bread into bite-sized pieces. Place both in a large bowl along with oil and toss to coat. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Reserve bowl for later use.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
9 slices whole grain bread
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place croutons in the oven and cook, tossing halfway through, until golden and crisp, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup balsamic vinegar
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and thinly slice shallot. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash and dry tomatoes; cut in half lengthwise and add to the bowl.
Wash and dry the basil. Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl.
Cut mozzarella into bite-sized pieces. Add mozzarella and croutons to the bowl and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (227 g) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear prosciutto into bite-sized pieces. Peel and halve eggs.
To serve, divide panzanella salad, eggs, and prosciutto between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
